register_device_stat_tracker: register a DeviceStatTracker singleton in a DependencyContainer for tracking GPU memory stats
resolve_device_stat_tracker: resolve a DeviceStatTracker from a DependencyResolver to get peak CUDA memory statistics
use_cuda_device_stat_tracker: create a CudaDeviceStatTracker to monitor peak active and reserved memory on a CUDA device
use_noop_device_stat_tracker: use the NOOP_DEVICE_STAT_TRACKER as a no-op fallback for CPU-only device stat tracking
use_device_stat_tracker_provider: use _DeviceStatTrackerProvider to get the appropriate tracker based on the root gang device type
